card.name: The word marked before a finding
card.fires_on: The word "marked" (often split as Mark + ed) used as an intensifier before a cardiovascular finding such as bradycardia, hypotension or electrolyte imbalance, mostly in contraindication and interaction lists.

modes.label: Mark + ed in lists
modes.description: The first part of "Marked" at the start of a contraindication bullet, before a condition.

modes.label: Marked after and/or
modes.description: The whole word "marked" after "hypotension and/or" or "or", before bradycardia.
